purpose: Keep the complete V7 terrain lane pixel-pure and independently certifiable while sharing topology policy with other style packs.
rules: Every pixel in the generated V7 atlas must originate from terrain-map-v7.png or terrain-v7.png.
Topology masks and shape identifiers may be shared with other style packs; source rectangles and source pixels may not be shared.
V7 world generation must not emit WetSand until a V7-authored wet-sand role exists; coastlines use Sand into Water_Shallows_Sand.
V7 families may not fall back to ElizaWy terrain, seasonal terrain, common-base terrain, or legacy mixed terrain.
The current mainland mixed integration is not part of the V7 lane and must remain labeled legacy_mixed until replaced.
